Small-area deprivation indices for England and Wales

Source: R/bundled.R
lamp_deprivation.Rd

The English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (IoD2025, 33,755 LSOAs) and the Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2025 (WIMD2025, 1,917 LSOAs), both on 2021 LSOAs, as a compact table for covariates and heterogeneity analysis. The two indices are separate national rankings built from different indicators, so ranks and deciles are comparable only within a country; rank / n_lsoas gives a within-country percentile. Domain deciles cover the seven domains the two indices share; Wales's community safety domain is held in decile_crime and its physical environment domain in decile_environment. England's domain deciles are as published; Wales's are formed within Wales from the published domain ranks, with the same thresholds as its published overall decile.

Usage

lamp_deprivation()

Value

A tibble with columns lsoa21, country, index, score (IMD score, England only), rank, decile (1 is most deprived), decile_income, decile_employment, decile_education, decile_health, decile_crime, decile_housing, decile_environment and n_lsoas.

Details

Sources: MHCLG, English indices of deprivation 2025, File 7 (published 30 October 2025, corrected 19 November 2025); Welsh Government, WIMD 2025 index and domain ranks by small area (published 27 November 2025). Both Open Government Licence v3.0; retrieved 2026-09-16.

See also

Other bundled data: lamp_area_lookup(), lamp_bank_holidays(), lamp_crime_types(), lamp_forces(), lamp_lsoa_lookup(), lamp_outcome_types(), lamp_sample_panel(), lamp_shocks()

Examples

dep <- lamp_deprivation()
table(dep$country, dep$decile)[, 1:3]
#>          
#>              1    2    3
#>   england 3375 3376 3375
#>   wales    191  191  192
